title: Project domain expiry
summary: Simulate a project domain or DNS record expiring during a release.

trigger.description: Users cannot reach the documented project endpoint or release instructions.

assumptions: The source repository remains the authoritative fallback.
DNS ownership and renewal responsibility can be documented without exposing credentials.

inputs.name: domain_owner
inputs.description: Reviewed ownership and renewal handoff for project domains.

score.formula: 100 minus bounded penalties for undocumented ownership, renewal, or source fallback

recovery_actions: Document the source-of-truth URL and renewal handoff.
Test communicating a release through the repository alone.
limitations: Does not query DNS or registrars.
Does not renew, redirect, or modify a domain.
